description: Get the description for the specified WCF relay.

operations.description: Returns the description for the specified WCF relay.

params.description: Name of the Resource group within the Azure subscription.
params.name: resourceGroupName

params.description: Subscription credentials which uniquely identify the Microsoft Azure subscription. The subscription ID forms part of the URI for every service call.
params.name: subscriptionId

props.description: The time the WCF relay was created.
props.name: createdAt

props.description: Returns true if the relay is dynamic; otherwise, false.
props.name: isDynamic

props.description: The number of listeners for this relay. Note that min :1 and max:25 are supported.
props.name: listenerCount

props.description: Returns true if client authorization is needed for this relay; otherwise, false.
props.name: requiresClientAuthorization

props.description: Returns true if transport security is needed for this relay; otherwise, false.
props.name: requiresTransportSecurity

props.description: The time the namespace was updated.
props.name: updatedAt

props.description: The usermetadata is a placeholder to store user-defined string data for the WCF Relay endpoint. For example, it can be used to store descriptive data, such as list of teams and their contact information. Also, user-defined configuration settings can be stored.
props.name: userMetadata

responses.description: Relay error response describing why the operation failed.
